text_a: The watchdog supervision timeout shall be 100 ms for all operating modes.
text_b: The software watchdog component shall be configured so that the watchdog supervision timeout is 250 ms.

text_a: The primary CAN bus shall operate at 500 kbit/s.
text_b: The supplied communication controller supports a maximum CAN bit rate of 250 kbit/s.

text_a: The ECU shall reach the operational state within 800 ms of power-on.
text_b: Cold-start initialization of the ECU completes within 1200 ms.

text_a: The ECU shall remain operational down to a supply voltage of 9.0 V.
text_b: The component is rated for a minimum supply voltage of 10.5 V.

text_a: The diagnostic event memory shall store up to 512 confirmed DTC entries.
text_b: The DTC memory buffer is dimensioned for 256 entries.

text_a: The system shall remain fully operational at ambient temperatures down to -40 degC.
text_b: The supplied sensor module is not rated for operation below -20 degC.

text_a: A diagnostic request shall receive a response within 50 ms.
text_b: The diagnostic routine requires at least 80 ms of processing time before a response can be produced.

text_a: ASIL-D functions shall be implemented on dual redundant processing channels.
text_b: The system is built on a single-controller architecture with no redundant processing channel.

text_a: Quiescent current in sleep mode shall not exceed 100 uA.
text_b: The CAN transceiver remains fully powered during sleep to enable bus wake-up, drawing approximately 5 mA.

text_a: Every diagnostic session shall require successful security authentication before any service is executed.
text_b: The default diagnostic session permits reading stored DTCs without authentication.

text_a: The startup task shall sequence boot indication as specified in SYS-REQ-0105.
text_b: Boot indication shall complete within 2000 ms. This requirement is superseded by SYS-REQ-0140.

text_a: DTC transmission timing shall follow the transport timing of COM-REQ-0103.
text_b: CAN transport layer timeout shall be 1000 ms. This requirement is superseded by COM-REQ-0145.

text_a: The supplied component conforms to the safety case defined in SAFE-REQ-0104.
text_b: The safety case assumes a watchdog-only supervision concept. This requirement is superseded by SAFE-REQ-0150.

text_a: The startup splash screen timing shall align with PWR-REQ-0104.
text_b: Startup inrush shall settle within 300 ms. This requirement is superseded by PWR-REQ-0160.

text_a: Freeze-frame capture shall reuse the signal set defined in DIAG-REQ-0104.
text_b: Freeze-frame shall capture 4 signal values. This requirement is superseded by DIAG-REQ-0110.

text_a: In normal operating mode the watchdog timeout shall be 100 ms.
text_b: In extended diagnostic mode the watchdog timeout shall be 250 ms.

text_a: The nominal supply voltage is 12 V.
text_b: The component operates across a supply range of 9 V to 16 V.

text_a: The boot animation shall complete in line with SYS-REQ-0140.
text_b: Boot completion shall be indicated to the driver within 1500 ms of ignition-on. This requirement replaces the withdrawn startup-indication requirement.

text_a: The ECU shall operate from -40 degC to +85 degC.
text_b: The qualified operating temperature range is -40 degC to +85 degC.

text_a: A diagnostic response shall be returned within 100 ms.
text_b: The diagnostic routine completes in a typical 40 ms.

text_a: The diagnostic Ethernet link shall operate at 100 Mbit/s using 100BASE-T1.
text_b: The supplier shall deliver the component with a minimum flash endurance of 100000 write cycles.

text_a: Warning telltales shall be rendered at a minimum luminance of 200 cd/m2.
text_b: An inactive diagnostic session shall time out after 5 seconds.

text_a: The fault reaction time for ASIL-B functions shall not exceed 200 ms.
text_b: Non-volatile data shall be stored in blocks of 256 bytes.

text_a: The ECU shall enter sleep mode after 4 seconds of bus inactivity.
text_b: The ECU shall support over-the-air software updates of up to 64 MB.

text_a: After a bus-off event the node shall attempt recovery after 100 ms.
text_b: Freeze-frame data shall capture the 8 most recent signal values at the time a DTC is set.

text_a: Application software shall be partitioned into 10 ms and 50 ms cyclic tasks.
text_b: Warning telltales shall be rendered at a minimum luminance of 200 cd/m2.

text_a: The ECU shall support over-the-air software updates of up to 64 MB.
text_b: The safety concept shall use combined watchdog and program-flow monitoring.

text_a: Startup inrush current shall settle within 250 ms.
text_b: The CAN transport layer timeout shall be 1500 ms.

text_a: Freeze-frame data shall capture the 8 most recent signal values at the time a DTC is set.
text_b: The ECU shall enter sleep mode after 4 seconds of bus inactivity.
